description: The native API a development trusted app window reaches: unrestricted HTTP(S) egress through the Tauri HTTP plugin (ADR-0179), the recording and transcription operations the public @epicenter/app client exposes (ADR-0186), and the text clipboard @epicenter/app/clipboard reads and writes. Not a sandbox, because an app window already runs as Epicenter on the shared origin; this file is API wiring, so it names product operations and never model administration, device enumeration, or unrelated Whispering authority. Whispering remains explicit until it joins the derived catalog.
